app.name: InvoiceFlow
app.one_liner: Invoices freelancers actually get paid on
app.idea_verbatim: I want to build something like Invoice Ninja but way simpler for freelancers.

validation.guardrail: If fewer than 10 paying users by day 45 → iterate (usage-based pricing) or kill.
risks: Stripe payout delays — watch chargeback rate in month 1
Freelancers churn if invoicing is not weekly-habit — activation metric on first invoice
Invoice Ninja / FreshBooks coverage — wedge is simplicity + 48h-payment framing

problem.statement: Freelancers send invoices in Word/PDF and chase payments by email for weeks.
problem.proof: Reddit r/freelance + r/webdev threads on late payments (2026); competitor reviews complain about setup complexity.
problem.workaround: Google Docs templates + email reminders by hand; accountants' spreadsheets.
problem.jtbd: When I invoice a client, I want payment in 48h so I don't chase emails.

must: Create + send an invoice with a client-pay link
Stripe Checkout on the pay link (one-time payment)
Dashboard with invoice list + payment status

flows: Signup → dashboard (empty state: create first invoice) → new invoice → client pays via link → status paid
Client opens pay link → sees invoice → pays with card → both get confirmation

data_model.sql:
users        (id uuid pk, email text unique, password_hash text, name text, created_at)
subscriptions(id uuid pk, user_id fk, stripe_customer_id, stripe_sub_id, status enum, current_period_end, created_at)
invoices     (id uuid pk, user_id fk, client_email, client_name, amount_cents, currency, status enum, stripe_session_id, created_at)
payments     (id uuid pk, invoice_id fk, provider_ref, amount_cents, created_at)

auth: email + password via Auth.js v5 (credentials provider); Google OAuth later (P2)
ownership: every query filters by eq(userId, session.user.id)
payments: Stripe Checkout Session (mode: payment) per invoice; metadata { userId, invoiceId }
webhook api/stripe/webhook verifies STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET; checkout.session.completed → mark invoice paid + insert payment
local test via stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3000/api/stripe/webhook

kpis.metric: Activated users (sent first invoice) + paid invoices + free→paid conversion
kpis.guardrail: If < 40 activated users after 4 weeks, iterate the onboarding

decisions: User said 'way simpler' → scoped to one-time invoices; subscriptions explicitly out of MVP
Defaulted to Vercel + Neon over Supabase for zero-config hosting
Free tier cap (3/mo) kept to create the upgrade path

features.value: Writes a short client-friendly payment reminder from the invoice
features.evals: 5 golden reminders; no invoice numbers in output

ai.non_ai_fallback: Template reminder text — always rendered even if the AI call fails
ai.kill_guardrail: If cost/user exceeds $0.15/mo or error rate > 5% → route to template-only mode

design.notes: Neutral shadcn tokens, indigo accent, Geist fonts; editorial calm — one CTA per screen

routes.purpose: Landing — hook, features, pricing preview, CTA
App home — invoice list, status stats, quick actions

pages.purpose: Hook-first pitch: get paid in 48h, not 6 weeks
pages.layout: marketing shell — navbar, hero, feature cards, pricing preview, FAQ accordion, footer
pages.components: navbar, hero, card, pricing table, accordion, footer

pages.name: Pricing
pages.purpose: Free vs Pro plan, one CTA

pages.name: Dashboard
pages.purpose: Invoice list + paid/draft/unpaid stats + quick actions
pages.components: sidebar, stat cards, data table, badge, dialog, sonner, button
pages.states: loading skeleton, empty state (create first invoice), error alert

pages.name: New invoice
pages.components: form, input, textarea, currency input, button, sonner

pages.name: Invoice detail
pages.purpose: View invoice, copy pay link, see payment status

pages.name: Client pay page
pages.purpose: Public invoice + pay button — no login
pages.components: card, invoice lines, button (Stripe Checkout redirect)

pages.name: Stripe webhook
pages.actions: verify signature → update invoice + insert payment

auth_flow: email + password via lib/auth.ts (Auth.js v5 credentials provider)
server reads auth(); client reads useSession(); loading state while hydrating
ownership: every query filters by session user.id — never trust the client
payments_flow: /dashboard sendInvoice → creates Stripe Checkout Session (mode: payment) with metadata { userId, invoiceId }
webhook api/stripe/webhook verifies with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET → checkout.session.completed → set invoices.status = paid + insert payments

workflows.title: Get paid on an invoice
steps: User signs up → lands on /dashboard (empty state: 'Create your first invoice')
Clicks New invoice → /invoices/new → fills form → submit createInvoice
List at /dashboard shows the invoice as draft; user clicks Send → pay link generated
Client opens /p/:token → sees invoice → pays with card on Stripe
Webhook marks invoice paid → /invoices/:id shows paid + confirmation
User sees payment reflected in /dashboard stats

workflows.title: Free → Pro upgrade
steps: /dashboard shows a Free plan badge once 3 invoices are used
CTA to /pricing → Stripe Checkout (subscription) → back with status active
Invoice cap lifts; reminder emails unlock

system_workflows.title: Auth (signup → session)
steps: POST /signup (server action) → zod validate → bcrypt hash → insert users → create session → redirect /dashboard

system_workflows.title: Invoice payment (one-time)
steps: sendInvoice action → creates a Checkout Session for amount_cents + stores stripe_session_id + pay token
checkout.session.completed webhook → verify signature → match invoiceId via metadata → set invoices.status = paid + insert payments

build_order.done: stripe listen marks invoice paid → commit
